data.title: PITB ICMS - District Case Management
data.summary: Provision and implementation of a district-level case management / workflow automation system for government use, including web-based access, role-based access control (RBAC), and bilingual (English/Urdu) interfaces. The scope also includes data migration from manual/spreadsheet systems, training for government staff, disaster recovery with RTO ≤ 4 hours, and post-deployment maintenance/support (including SLA commitments) for three years.

deadlines.label: Written clarification requests deadline
deadlines.raw: Written clarification requests must be received by 5th August 2026.

deadlines.label: Pre-bid query session
deadlines.raw: A pre-bid query session will be held on 10th August 2026.

deadlines.label: Proposal submission deadline
deadlines.raw: Bidders must submit both technical and financial proposals in separate sealed envelopes no later than 17:00 hours on 25th August 2026.

criteria.name: Weighted technical and financial evaluation (minimum technical score required)
criteria.description: Technical and financial proposals will be evaluated using weighted criteria. A minimum technical score of 70% is required to qualify for financial evaluation.

qa_items.question: Describe your organization's experience in implementing similar case management or workflow automation systems for government clients in Pakistan.
Provide details of your proposed technical architecture, including technology stack, hosting environment, and security measures to be implemented.
Describe your approach to data migration from the existing manual / spreadsheet-based systems used by district offices, including data cleansing and validation steps.
Detail your proposed training plan for government staff, including the number of sessions, training materials, and post-training support.
Explain your maintenance and support model for the three-year post-deployment period, including your SLA commitments and escalation procedures.

data.submission_instructions: Submit both technical and financial proposals in separate sealed envelopes no later than 17:00 hours on 25th August 2026. Proposals must be submitted in three (3) hard copies and one (1) soft copy on USB drive, addressed to the Procurement Committee, Provincial IT Board, Lahore. Bids submitted via email will not be accepted.
